global_risks: CRITICAL: Hardcoded credentials or tokens detected in codebase; immediate rotation and IAM review required
HIGH: Grammar parse errors detected in source files, preventing complete AST thermodynamic analysis
recommended_priorities: 1. Remediate CRITICAL and HIGH security findings (credential masking, process command injection, SQL concatenation)
2. Execute AUTOMATION_READY hygiene items (Docker non-root USER, pinned base image tags, license creation)
3. Address architectural dependency cycles to restore clean modular boundaries
4. Refactor functions with extreme cyclomatic complexity (M >= 20) under automated regression test gates
limitations: Static taint analysis for SQL/exec execution is heuristic and flags potential patterns without inter-procedural dataflow verification
Unit test presence is audited by directory co-location; multi-package integration suites located in root test dirs may cause benign NOTEST warnings
Diagnostic reporting is strictly read-only and does not mutate source code or execute remediation patches
